About.title: About
About.description: Results-driven Senior Software Engineer and PMP-certified technologist with 10 years of experience leading the delivery of scalable web products from concept to launch. Known for driving cross-functional teams of up to <bold>20 engineers</bold> while maintaining high standards for quality and on-time execution — most recently scaling a front-end platform from <bold>1 to 10 products</bold> in under a year at million-user scale, with a strong track record of performance improvements, reusable system design, and <bold>AI-assisted planning</bold>.

Experience.title: Experience
Experience.description: 10+ years of building and leading high-performance engineering teams.

highlights: Scaled a chain of market website products from 1 to 10 live products in under 12 months by architecting a shared front-end codebase (Next.js/Nuxt.js) with reusable component libraries and standardized design patterns.
Drove front-end performance initiatives achieving Lighthouse scores >90 on both desktop and mobile, improving Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, FID) under high-traffic conditions serving millions of users.
Delivered on-time releases across consecutive quarters by introducing structured sprint planning, blocker tracking, and engineering workflows — zero missed customer-facing deadlines.
Coordinated engineering, product, and operational stakeholders across front-end (Next.js/Nuxt.js) and back-end (PHP) modules; managed delivery risks and dependencies to ensure predictable releases.
Architected reusable front-end structures and design patterns across multiple products, enabling faster onboarding and reducing per-project setup time significantly.
Defined and enforced Git workflow, coding conventions, and code review standards — improving consistency and engineering quality across a multi-team environment.
Ensured technical health through systematic code review and engineering standards, reducing regression bugs and improving maintainability.
Coordinated cross-team delivery to align front-end and back-end work against performance, quality, and release milestones.
Owned front-end system architecture and reduced technical debt by standardizing implementation patterns across the codebase.
Supervised system modifications and ensured engineering quality through structured reviews and mentoring.
Managed Agile execution to support prioritization, planning, and delivery coordination.
Hired, supervised, and mentored team members to improve delivery quality and team effectiveness.
Developed and maintained production modules with focus on correctness, performance, and maintainability.
Monitored system performance and supported investigation and troubleshooting with the engineering team.
Collected client requirements and translated them into engineering deliverables; received Outstanding Performance Award (2018).

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: A selection of projects that showcase impact at scale, from million-user platforms to enterprise solutions.

aiPlanning.title: AI Planning Project
highlights: Built an AI-powered planning system that scans Jira project releases and estimates delivery timelines based on configured team resources.
Generated detailed release plans including milestones, start dates, end dates, Gantt charts, and resource allocation.
Improved release visibility and planning accuracy by combining Jira data, AI estimation, and configurable delivery capacity.

chain.title: Chain of Websites
highlights: Scaled platform from 1 to 10 live products in under 12 months with a shared front-end architecture.
Achieved Lighthouse scores >90 on desktop and mobile through systematic performance optimization.
Delivered continuous releases under high traffic for a platform serving millions of users.

diginex.title: Diginex ESG Platform
highlights: Built and delivered the Diginex ESG ecosystem: reporting, materiality prioritization, progress tracking, and climate workflows.

supply.title: Supply Chains Tracing Project
highlights: Led delivery for a platform supporting downstream tracing of goods related to child labor and forced labor compliance.

qnet.title: QNet Reporting System
highlights: Delivered and evolved enterprise reporting workflows (designer, reader, data provider) in partnership with Ford Motor Company.

zmining.title: ZMining Ecosystem
highlights: Led front-end structure and delivery for automation workflows across desktop and browser environments.
